title: Super flumina babilonis (Medici Codex) (C. Festa)
desc: Costanzo Festa, Super flumina babilonis (Medici Codex). 5 voices (Superius, Altus, Tenor I, Tenor II, Bassus), each on its own staff. Source: Medici Codex. No text in this edition. Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve), at the original pitch; coloured notes stand for the triplet groups; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
